title: 大迪克桑斯壩~Grande Dixence Dam
focus: 以大迪克桑斯重力壩高山集水與壩基監測學習~Studying Grande Dixence gravity action alpine collection and foundation monitoring
summary: 本課以以大迪克桑斯重力壩高山集水與壩基監測學習為主線，先用高山集水與季節庫存與高壩投影水壓界定水力與構造條件，再將合力偏心與接觸、水化熱與拘束連結到高落差輸水與淨能量。公開高度與年代僅作案例背景，合成斷面不等於真實壩形，所有安全比值均非設計評定。 每單元以原創算例、量測與失效辨識共同檢查推論。~This course develops studying Grande Dixence gravity action alpine collection and foundation monitoring through Alpine collection and seasonal storage and High dam projected hydrostatic load, then connects Resultant eccentricity and contact and Hydration heat and restraint to High-head conveyance and net energy. Public height and dates provide context only; synthetic sections are not the actual dam and calculated ratios are not design assessments. Each unit combines original calculation, measurement and failure diagnosis to test the inference.
history: 大迪克桑斯壩位於瑞士高山，業主資料確認其為285m高的重力壩，建設期為1951至1961年，並自1961年起啟用。業主另列原Dixence、Cleuson及後續擴建的不同階段，本課保持各壩與系統年代的區別，不將整體水電系統的高程差混同壩高。課程以自重、水壓、揚力、熱變形與廊道監測建立力學路徑，再連到高山集水與發電能量。全部計算採合成斷面及參數，未使用真實壩體剖面推定安全係數或現場狀態。~The owner identifies Grande Dixence as a285m gravity dam, built during1951–1961 and commissioned from1961. Its history distinguishes the original Dixence, Cleuson and later scheme phases, which are kept separate here. Scheme elevation difference is not dam height. Lessons connect weight, water pressure, uplift, thermal movement and gallery monitoring to alpine collection and generation. Synthetic sections and parameters do not assess the actual dam’s safety or present condition.
example: 整合算例輸入全為教學假設，先檢查高山集水與季節庫存：SyntheticCollectedFlow=12 m3/s for20 days; collectedVolume=12*20*86400/1e6=20.736 million m3；再獨立檢查高壩投影水壓：SyntheticWaterDepth=180 m; unitWidth=1 m; hydrostaticForce=0.5*9.81*180**2=158922 kN per m width。敏感度：合成底面總下向力90000kN與摩擦係數0.7不變，揚力由20000增至30000kN，摩擦抗力由49000降至42000kN，減少14.29%；不能假設排水永久維持初始效果。 兩個結果須按各自量綱解釋，不能直接相加或當成完整設計。公開高度與年代僅作案例背景，合成斷面不等於真實壩形，所有安全比值均非設計評定。 將保持試段長度壓差一致並比較帷幕上下游孔壓作為獨立驗證，明確列出尚缺的現地輸入及其對結論的影響。~Every input in this integrated example is a teaching assumption. First examine Alpine collection and seasonal storage: SyntheticCollectedFlow=12 m3/s for20 days; collectedVolume=12*20*86400/1e6=20.736 million m3. Independently examine High dam projected hydrostatic load: SyntheticWaterDepth=180 m; unitWidth=1 m; hydrostaticForce=0.5*9.81*180**2=158922 kN per m width. Sensitivity: with90000kN downward force and0.7 friction coefficient, raising uplift from20000 to30000kN reduces frictional resistance from49000 to42000kN, or14.29 percent. Drainage cannot be assumed permanently effective at its initial state. Interpret each result in its own dimensions rather than adding them or treating them as a complete design. Public height and dates provide context only; synthetic sections are not the actual dam and calculated ratios are not design assessments. Use the following independent check: Match interval length and pressure and compare heads on both sides of the curtain. Identify missing field inputs and state which conclusions depend on them.

units.anchor: 高山集水與季節庫存~Alpine collection and seasonal storage
units.title: 高山集水與季節庫存~Alpine collection and seasonal storage
units.mechanism: 大迪克桑斯系統將高山集水與蓄水發電連結，融雪、降雨與輸水設備共同限制可收集水量。流量積分只表示指定時窗的輸入，不代表全部都可用於發電；溢流、抽水耗能及生態放流需在共同水量邊界另列。 驗證時應將各支流取水與庫存變化對帳並區分抽水輸入與自然入流，並辨識以下失效情境：只加總取水量會漏掉輸水損失與非發電放流。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Grande Dixence links alpine collection with storage and generation. Snowmelt, rainfall and conveyance capacity constrain captured water. Integrated flow describes one input window, not fully usable generating water; spills, pumping demand and environmental releases belong in the same accounting boundary. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Reconcile tributary collection with storage and distinguish pumped from natural inflow. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Summing collection alone omits conveyance losses and nongenerating releases. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
units.model: 原創教學假設：SyntheticCollectedFlow=12 m3/s for20 days; collectedVolume=12*20*86400/1e6=20.736 million m3。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: SyntheticCollectedFlow=12 m3/s for20 days; collectedVolume=12*20*86400/1e6=20.736 million m3. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Summing collection alone omits conveyance losses and nongenerating releases. units.anchor: 高壩投影水壓~High dam projected hydrostatic load
units.title: 高壩投影水壓~High dam projected hydrostatic load
units.mechanism: 重力壩以自身重量及地基作用抵抗水平水壓，水深增加使三角分布合力按平方成長。單寬投影式只是二維自由體的一項，壩體實際幾何、尾水與地震水動力需另列；不能以公共壩高直接替代運轉水深。 驗證時應以同時庫尾水位及實測斷面建立完整荷載圖，並辨識以下失效情境：把結構總高度當滿水深會錯置受壓範圍與力矩。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~A gravity dam resists horizontal water action through weight and foundation interaction. The triangular resultant grows with depth squared. A unit-width projection is one term in a two-dimensional free body; actual geometry, tailwater and seismic hydrodynamics remain separate, and public dam height is not operating depth. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Build the complete load diagram from simultaneous reservoir and tailwater levels and surveyed sections. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Using total structural height as water depth misplaces the loaded area and moment. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.

units.anchor: 混凝土自重與質量~Concrete weight and mass
units.title: 混凝土自重與質量~Concrete weight and mass
units.mechanism: 壩體混凝土的密度與體積先給質量，再乘重力才得到重量，兩者不可混用。合成單寬斷面自重須使用斷面面積與厚度，廊道和空洞另扣；重心位置同樣重要，因其決定抵抗力矩而不只總重量。 驗證時應核對廊道扣除與重心位置並分別列出質量及重量單位，並辨識以下失效情境：漏扣大廊道或錯置重心會同時影響自重與穩定力矩。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Density and volume yield mass; multiplying by gravity yields weight. A synthetic unit-width section needs area and thickness, with galleries and voids deducted. The centroid matters as much as total weight because it sets the resisting moment rather than merely the downward force. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Check gallery deductions and centroid and distinguish mass units from force units. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Omitted galleries or a misplaced centroid alter weight and stability moments. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.

units.anchor: 底面揚力與排水~Base uplift and drainage
units.title: 底面揚力與排水~Base uplift and drainage
units.mechanism: 底面孔壓降低有效下向接觸力，防滲帷幕與排水需要分別檢查。線性水頭分布僅為明示假設，排水孔附近及節理連通可使實際分布不線性；不能只測單一孔壓就推定整個底面揚力，還需監測排水能力。 驗證時應沿底面廊道孔壓與排水流量核對假設分布，並辨識以下失效情境：排水堵塞會讓既有線性低壓假設失去依據。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Base pressure reduces effective downward contact. Grout curtains and drains need distinct checks. A linear head profile is an explicit assumption; drains and connected joints can make the real distribution nonlinear. One pressure reading cannot determine total uplift, so monitor pressure distribution and drainage performance together. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare gallery piezometers and drainage flow with the assumed base-pressure profile. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Drain blockage invalidates an assumed low-pressure profile. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.

units.anchor: 合力偏心與接觸~Resultant eccentricity and contact
units.title: 合力偏心與接觸~Resultant eccentricity and contact
units.mechanism: 單寬底面合力的偏心決定線彈性接觸壓力分布，核心範圍判斷須明示底面不能承拉或可承拉的模型。矩形全接觸公式在算出拉應力時已提示假設可能失效，不能保留負接觸壓力繼續當真實地基反力。 驗證時應以完整荷載力矩求合力位置並核對接觸模型是否允許拉力，並辨識以下失效情境：超出全接觸適用範圍仍用線性式會錯估壓縮區。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Resultant eccentricity controls the linear base-pressure distribution. State whether tension can be transferred. A full-contact rectangular formula that predicts tension signals a possible breakdown of its own assumption; negative contact pressure should not simply be retained as a real foundation reaction. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Locate the resultant from all moments and check whether the contact model permits tension. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Using full-contact equations beyond their range misstates the compressed area. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
units.model: 原創教學假設：SyntheticBaseWidth=60 m; resultantEccentricity=8 m; middleThirdLimit=60/6=10 m; geometricMargin=10-8=2 m。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: SyntheticBaseWidth=60 m; resultantEccentricity=8 m; middleThirdLimit=60/6=10 m; geometricMargin=10-8=2 m. units.anchor: 抗滑摩擦與揚壓~Sliding friction and uplift
units.title: 抗滑摩擦與揚壓~Sliding friction and uplift
units.mechanism: 摩擦抗力取決於有效正力而非總自重，揚壓、地震與不同荷載組合會改變可用接觸。無黏聚簡式只估一項抗力，不能代表含節理岩體的完整穩定；接觸面粗糙、剪脹及強度退化需由適當試驗與分析建立。 驗證時應核對揚壓量測與接觸剪力試驗並分列各荷載組合，並辨識以下失效情境：用總自重計摩擦會高估有揚壓時的抗滑能力。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Friction depends on effective normal force rather than gross weight. Uplift and load combinations alter contact. A cohesionless expression estimates one resistance component, not complete stability in jointed rock; roughness, dilation and degradation require suitable testing and analysis before using a strength parameter. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Check measured uplift and interface shear testing and list load combinations separately. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Using gross weight for friction overstates resistance when uplift acts. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.

units.anchor: 水化熱與拘束~Hydration heat and restraint
units.title: 水化熱與拘束~Hydration heat and restraint
units.mechanism: 大量混凝土的內外溫差與基礎拘束可形成熱應力，澆置分塊及降溫歷程影響開裂。單軸完全拘束且橫向可自由變形的線彈性公式只是應力量級，實際徐變、成熟度與裂縫會鬆弛應力；應用溫度與應變同步紀錄判斷，而非只量表面溫度。 驗證時應比較核心表面溫度與埋設應變並記錄混凝土齡期，並辨識以下失效情境：忽略徐變或拘束差異會使彈性熱應力被誤當實測值。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Mass concrete develops thermal stress through gradients and restraint. Block placement and cooling history affect cracking. An elastic estimate with full axial restraint and free lateral deformation gives a uniaxial stress scale only; creep, maturity and cracking relax stress. Interpret temperature and strain together rather than using surface temperature as the full thermal state. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare core and surface temperatures with embedded strain and concrete age. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Ignoring creep or restraint differences turns an elastic estimate into a false measured stress. units.anchor: 帷幕試驗與滲透~Curtain testing and permeability
units.title: 帷幕試驗與滲透~Curtain testing and permeability
units.mechanism: 灌漿帷幕應改變裂隙導水而非只追求灌入量，取芯、壓水與監測資料共同評估效果。前後流量比只能在同壓差及試段條件下比較，不能直接等同整壩滲透率降幅；地下水路重分配需靠廊道孔壓與流量追蹤。 驗證時應保持試段長度壓差一致並比較帷幕上下游孔壓，並辨識以下失效情境：只看灌漿量多會誤把遠處流失當有效封堵。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~A grout curtain should alter fracture conductance, not merely absorb grout volume. Compare pressure tests, cores and monitoring. A before-and-after flow ratio requires matching test intervals and pressure; it does not directly equal whole-dam permeability reduction because pathways may redistribute through the foundation. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Match interval length and pressure and compare heads on both sides of the curtain. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Large grout take can represent loss elsewhere instead of effective sealing. units.anchor: 垂線位移與溫度~Plumb-line movement and temperature
units.title: 垂線位移與溫度~Plumb-line movement and temperature
units.mechanism: 壩內垂線與外部測量可追蹤壩體位移，但基準點穩定與溫度水位效應需分開。差值代表相對運動而非絕對地盤移動，參考端本身若漂移需額外控制；應用長期可逆模式辨認新的不可逆殘差。 驗證時應以外部控制網與倒垂線比較基準穩定並核對季節循環，並辨識以下失效情境：基準端移動可使壩體看似發生相反方向位移。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Internal plumb lines and external surveys track movement, but reference stability and temperature-stage effects need separation. A difference is relative motion, not absolute ground movement. If the reference moves, independent control is needed; use reversible long-term patterns to identify a new irreversible residual. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare reference stability using external control and inverted plumb lines and check seasonal cycles. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Reference movement can make the dam appear to move in the opposite direction. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.

units.anchor: 高落差輸水與淨能量~High-head conveyance and net energy
units.title: 高落差輸水與淨能量~High-head conveyance and net energy
units.mechanism: 高山蓄水到低處電廠的高程差提供勢能，輸水損失與抽水投入則影響淨能量。以指定流量與淨水頭估出力只代表單一工作點，不能把壩高等同全系統落差；水路壓力、暫態與機組效率需另作聯合驗證。 驗證時應同步核對上下游能量線機組功率及抽水投入，並辨識以下失效情境：把發電毛能量當淨收益會漏掉抽水與輸水損失。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Elevation difference from alpine storage to lower generating plants supplies potential energy, while losses and pumping inputs affect net benefit. Power at specified flow and net head is one operating point. Dam height is not total scheme head; waterway pressures, transients and efficiency require joint verification. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Check energy lines, generating power and pumping input over matching periods. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Treating gross generation as net benefit omits pumping input and conveyance losses.
